info.name: Smart Waiting Line System - Multi-Track A/B/C
info.description:
Spec-focused API suite for the Smart Waiting Line System.

Assumed baseline before running the collection:
- tenant `tenant-001`
- both counters are closed
- no tickets exist

The provided PowerShell runner resets `data/tenants/tenant-001/counters.json` and `data/tenants/tenant-001/tickets.json` to the matching fixtures in `tests/api/fixtures/tenant-001-baseline/` before starting a fresh backend.

Known current backend mismatches this collection is expected to expose:
- protected counter/ticket routes authorize `staff`, but the seeded second user is role `agent`
- `POST /api/tickets` validation requires `serviceId`, while the controller/service actually use `track` and `customerType`
- queue status is verified through `GET /api/tickets` because no public queue-status route is wired
